headlines.title: At least 7 Palestinians killed by Israeli forces over past 48 hours in Gaza
headlines.snippet: At least seven Palestinians have been killed by Israeli forces in Gaza over the past 48 hours, with nine more bodies recovered from the rubble. This information comes from Gaza's Ministry of Health.
